name: East Success Couloir
overview: Approach via the Westside Road, Paradise, or Van Trump Meadows, then ascend the Success Couloir that lies farthest east, on snow of 45+ degrees. From Paradise or Van Trump the easiest line may be to cross the lower part of the Kautz Glacier and head up the Kautz Cleaver, then angle into the couloir. A lengthy snow ramp climbs nearly straight up. Rock bands may show near 12,600 feet and 13,300 depending on snow. Near 13,000 feet it follows an airy traverse above cliffs, then cuts back left and up to Point Success. Crevassing is minimal, and apart from the steady steepness there is little technical difficulty; with its southern exposure it may suit spring skiing better than climbing.
